summary.text: Nous Research develops AI models, builds apps for using them, and runs a training test network called Psyche.
Nous Research, Inc. operates the services, and Dillon Rolnick is its chief executive, according to the company.
You can use Hermes Agent on your computer or through a hosted dashboard, and the software is free to run yourself, Nous Research says.
Psyche pools computing power and uses Solana to coordinate training, and Nous Research says it used Psyche to refine a Hermes model.
Nous Portal connects the agent to models and tools and offers a free plan and paid plans from $20 a month, the project says.
API calls use prepaid credits, and paid personal plans include one cloud agent within size limits, according to Nous Portal.
Joining a NousNet training run requires approval, and the Psyche team’s test network terms say its test tokens have no monetary value.
The checked Psyche programs run on Solana’s test network, and the ledger records their upgrade addresses while the key holders remain unidentified.

differs.why: The company dates formation to 2023. The Fortune interview dates the volunteer group to 2022. These may refer to different stages.
Nous lists a February 25 public release. Microsoft calls March the launch month and does not specify a different release milestone.

The April 2025 report describes NOUS rewards as operating. The contemporary interview says the reward asset was undecided, and official material documents only test assets and disclaims a company token.

The October article described absence. The later check found a non-executable token account at the published coordinator address. The collection date and tested addresses differ, so the two readings do not establish a contradiction.

open_questions: Who, if anyone publicly identified, controls the coordinator upgrade address and the separate authorizer upgrade address?
Is there an official Psyche mainnet deployment at different addresses, and which coordinator would it use?
Which Psyche runs are currently open for compute providers and what is the operator’s approval process?
Has any Psyche participant received a reward with monetary value, and what asset and funding source were used?
Which Nous Research activities took place in 2022 before its stated 2023 formation?
Does Nous use Portal or enterprise revenue to fund Psyche compute rewards?
notes: Research snapshot for November 24, 2026. Nous links the published coordinator from its Hermes 4.3 release, so the infobox uses that deployment. The pinned Psyche repository names another deployed coordinator that the public transaction history shows handling later training instructions. The explorer page loaded its address and cluster shell, while the account and transaction checks came directly from Solana’s public RPC. Solana records blocks by slot here. Account calls reproduce the checks on a finalized bank at or after the observed slot. Historical state at an exact old slot requires an archive node with historical account state or a saved snapshot. The saved transaction signatures work independently of those account snapshots. The Psyche dashboard and documentation host timed out on direct reads. The repository’s pinned documentation and the cached Phase 0 terms were readable. X blocked direct access and several other social hosts throttled or restricted access. Official account ties rely on the project’s links. Public signing addresses identify keys, and the RPC responses do not identify their holders. The Size row measures model use recorded by OpenRouter. The project’s earliest exact public launch date remains unverified, so the Launched row uses the year of its own formation statement and dated public releases. No earlier results or channels were supplied.
